tagline: STIHL equipment, local advice, gear that lasts
heroSubheading: STIHL equipment, servicing and advice for Kerikeri locals.
aboutHtml:
Mathew and Kimberley Vincent run STIHL SHOP Waipapa. We stock STIHL equipment because it's what we trust—reliable, built to last, and designed for the work Kerikeri does every day. Whether it's routine maintenance, clearing sections, or contract work on building sites, we have the gear and the knowledge to help.

We sell chainsaws, trimmers, blowers and spare parts. We service equipment when it needs attention, and we give straight advice about which tools suit the job best. Whether you're clearing sections, looking after council reserves, or managing rental properties, you'll find what you need here.

Come in and see us. We're open Monday to Friday and Saturday mornings, and we'll help make sure you've got what you need.
